reviewed_by: Claude review of pre-existing interface.spec.ts harness failures
reason: Three interface.spec.ts failures were red on pristine origin/main and blocked every UI pull request, because recent merges were Python-only and never ran the Playwright matrix. (1) The global API stub answers an array for any unrecognised path, so the credentials/vault endpoint added by #374 read as an unavailable vault and every credential dialog silently downgraded to session-only storage; 'VPN settings keep upload and project routing calm at every width' expected persistence 'vault' and received 'session' at all widths. The stub now answers {state: available}. (2) The tool-follow-up-runtime-required desktop baseline was 380x85 while both CI and a local run render 381x85 with identical content; the CI-rendered actual replaces it. (3) Mobile emulation scales layout by the device pixel ratio, so a 44px control measured 43.999969482421875 and failed 'conversation More actions remain usable on mobile Workbench navigation' on mobile-chromium-small only; the 44px assertions now go through one expectTouchTarget helper that rounds to hundredths, the pattern one site in this file already used. Only test files and one snapshot change; no product code is touched.
exclusions: No python tests: no src/nebula change. No frontend tests: no ui/src change, so no vitest file is affected. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. Playwright runs the full matrix because ui/tests/** is a full_pattern in ui/playwright-impact.json, which is the right coverage for a change to the shared interface spec: it re-runs every width that surfaced these three failures.
